weighting.definition: Each CKT track is normalized by its own row weights; occurrences receive track weights character/word2/word3/word4 = 1/3/1/1, then all syllable positions are normalized together.

relocationProxy.definition: Exact weighted toned-syllable top-1 change after moving one whole family to the stated destination; no-flying is preserved, but motor and word-code competition are not modeled.

proxyCaveat: idealSeparationGainShare is a collision-only upper proxy: the family is imagined to move without new collisions, while motor cost, word-code competition, and destination feasibility are ignored.
